project: NHS England Cancer Waiting Times Advanced Research Lakehouse

nhs_cwt_national_timeseries.parquet.description: Monthly national time-series of the 3 CWT standards and suspected referral volumes.

fields.period: First day of the reporting month (DATE)
fields.fds_compliance_pct: Percentage of patients receiving diagnostic outcome within 28 days (DOUBLE, target: 80%)
fields.wait62_compliance_pct: Percentage of cancer patients commencing treatment within 62 days (DOUBLE, target: 85%)
fields.wait31_compliance_pct: Percentage of cancer patients commencing treatment within 31 days of DTT (DOUBLE, target: 96%)
fields.total_urgent_referrals_seen: Monthly volume of urgent suspected cancer referrals seen at first outpatient appointment (BIGINT)

nhs_cwt_trust_decoupling_mart.parquet.description: Institutional mart evaluating 137 NHS acute hospital trusts.

fields.TRUST_NAME: Official legal name of NHS Trust (VARCHAR)
fields.operational_quadrant: Classification: Resilient, Bottleneck Decoupled, Diagnostic Lag, Systemic Distress (VARCHAR)

nhs_cwt_modality_bottlenecks.parquet.description: Treatment modality throughput and breach volumes (Surgery, Anti-cancer drugs, Radiotherapy).

fields.TREATMENT_MODALITY: Clinical intervention class: Surgery, Anti-cancer drug regimen, Radiotherapy, Other (VARCHAR)

nhs_cwt_queue_survival_distribution.parq.description: Wait duration queueing distribution and survival probability S(t) across tumours.

fields.pct_waiting_past_104d: Empirical probability P(T > 104 days) - Extreme backlog rate (DOUBLE)
